bagPolicy.summary: Small bags and purses no larger than 12 × 12 × 6 inches are allowed; larger bags and backpacks are prohibited. Security may inspect bags at entry.
prohibited: Bags and backpacks larger than 12 × 12 × 6 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: First-come, first-served street parking is available on Elston and Magnolia; nearby paid lots include one at 939 West North Avenue.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The designated Lyft pickup and drop-off zone is on Magnolia Avenue near the entrance; look for pink Lyft signs.
rideshare.note: Use the designated rideshare pickup and drop-off area on Magnolia Avenue near the entrance. Look for pink Lyft signs.

concessions.summary: Food and beverages are sold at shows, with indoor and outdoor menus varying by performance. The venue is cashless and prohibits outside food and drinks.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue is wheelchair accessible, and accessible grandstand seats are sold for indoor shows. Request an ASL interpreter at least three weeks ahead.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Salt Shed does not permit re-entry.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is near 1200 W Blackhawk, by the main gate. It is open on show nights from door time until the end of the show, and every Friday from 9:30 a.m. to 2 p.m. Reduced-fee box office purchases are limited to two tickets per person.

gates.summary: The main gate and box office are near 1200 West Blackhawk Street. Security screens people and bags at entry; the show’s listing supplies its door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
